review_scope: EX020 final report, fixed-grid execution evidence, annual objective arithmetic, account/path checks and publication preconditions; publication itself not executed by this reviewer.
checks: Eight actual COMPLETE Optuna trials match C0025..C0032 account records and the predeclared ordered grid; all enqueued before results, no free sampling or pruning. Actual sampler is RandomSampler, not GridSampler.
Each trial worst-target-margin independently recalculated from annual comparison and actual full-window closed-trade frequency; matches trial value and account record.

Seventy annual rows across ten formal account references independently recalculated from daily NAV including previous year-end opening NAV; strict drawdown, positive-BH 1.5x return and nonpositive-BH strictly-positive return checks match.
Full-window frequency is 60 times CLOSED trades divided by 1642; OPEN trades excluded. All ten account exact pass flags agree, and no account passes every original target.
All eight runtime closure hashes authenticate actual source files; strategy source matches causal precheck and independent ledger audit.
246 causal/boundary prechecks and 153704 actual-account checks passed. Full audit bytes and SHA agree with the compact summary.
Path script and all declared CSV output hashes agree; ten accounts at two cutoffs reconcile cycle-log returns to account returns, max absolute return error 1.7763568394002505e-15.
Report complete account and C0028 annual tables, exposure, fees, path contributions and event counts match the underlying comparison, path and audit evidence.
Report correctly describes development-sample selection, absence of independent unseen validation and unverified historical publication/revision/adjustment-factor availability.
Report correctly says zero fully passing accounts and no stage-four readiness; account audit PASS is not an economic acceptance.

Publication script reads current autonomous budget, increments completed only, and preserves allocated and remaining-unallocated fields; result explicitly separates allocated-uncompleted and unallocated capacity.

Final report supplement explicitly and accurately contrasts C0028 with H6: +41.449183 percentage points full-window, -11.687493 percentage points through 2025; full-window return ranking depends on 2026.
limitations_to_preserve: C0028 is the best cumulative-return configuration in the already-seen fixed grid, not an independently validated optimum.
Before 2026, C0028 return is 55.680275%, above original H3 13.570849% but below original H6 67.367768%; final report now explicitly discloses this reversal against H6.
Cycle-log matched/missing/new-entry terms are an accounting decomposition, not independent causal effects. Entry cohorts differ from natural NAV years.

C0028 has 43 missing original-H3 entries, of which 19 were profitable and 24 losing; zero occur on C0028 liquidation dates. This supports not adding a one-day liquidation memory rule for this result, not a universal proof that memory can never help.
All real-account post-SELL-latch renewal-signal counts are zero; that special interaction is covered by explicit synthetic tests, not observed historical cases.
EX021 changes the full entry/support/startup mechanism; its subsequent difference must not be called a pure continuation change.
Budget is an upper bound; this review does not update the registration budget, execute EX021 or authorize a new research stage.
